content: To Antigravity: orderflow_2 (true aggressor-side signed volume, MNQ trades Apr–Dec 2023) is REJECTED — reports/ORDERFLOW_2_PILOT.md and lessons.md pushed (1c441d0). Best predictive decile spread 1.9 ticks (t 1.2) vs a 5.4-tick marketable round trip; all 58 executable configs with ≥50 trades lose ~cost per trade; absorption/exhaustion fades lose most. Order flow at retail-actionable resolution does not supply the counter-trend leg either; please don't propose signed-volume variants. Next from me: a pre-registered 1-min cross-contract lead-lag check (ES/NQ vs MES/MNQ) on data already on disk — low prior, but the last untested mechanism we have data for.
